patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient comes in for a routine checkup without any specific complaints. He maintains an active lifestyle with jogging and gardening. He has been retired since age 50 and enjoys spending his mornings in the park and afternoons in his garden.

Symptoms.Primary_Symptom: Presence of a lesion on the scalp

patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: No history of smoking. Drinks alcohol occasionally.
patient_actor_hidden.Review_of_Systems: Denies any symptoms of fatigue, weight loss, fever, or other systemic symptoms.

objective_for_doctor: Perform a routine checkup on a 68-year-old man, assess any dermatological findings, and formulate a diagnosis.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Hi doctor—I'm here for a routine checkup. I’ve noticed a lesion on my scalp, but otherwise I feel well and I haven’t had any fatigue, weight loss, or fever.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any swelling in your joints?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any joint swelling or unusual aches—my joints feel about the same. I’ve been keeping active with jogging and gardening without any new problems.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been experiencing any itching or a feeling of itchiness anywhere on your body?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any itching or unusual itchiness anywhere. The only thing I’ve noticed is the lesion on my scalp, and everything else feels normal.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you have any trouble lifting your arms above your head?
turns.patient_answer: “No trouble lifting my arms above my head—I can raise them fully without any weakness or pain. I’ve been able to keep up with my usual jogging and gardening.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any loss of vision that isn’t accompanied by pain?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any loss of vision, and there’s been no vision change that comes with pain either. My eyes feel normal, and I haven’t had any concerning symptoms beyond the lesion on my scalp.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you had a fever that’s felt extremely hot—like a temperature above 104 °F (40 °C) that’s made you feel dizzy or very uncomfortable?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any fever—nothing over 104°F, and I’ve not felt dizzy or extremely uncomfortable. I’ve generally been feeling well aside from the lesion on my scalp.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling unusually stressed or overwhelmed lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t felt unusually stressed or overwhelmed. My routine has been steady, and I’m still enjoying my mornings at the park and afternoons in my garden.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you experienced any burning or discomfort when you urinate?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any burning or discomfort when I urinate. Everything in that area feels normal, and I haven’t noticed any urinary changes.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling chills lately?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any chills, and I haven’t felt any feverish episodes. I’ve been feeling generally well—just the scalp lesion is what brought me in.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any lumps or masses in your breasts that feel fixed or don’t move?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any lumps or masses in my chest or breasts, and nothing fixed or that wouldn’t move. I haven’t had any related pain or skin changes there either.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been feeling any pain or discomfort on the side of your back or abdomen, between your ribs and hips?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t had any pain or discomfort in my back or abdomen between my ribs and hips. I’ve been feeling comfortable in those areas and my daily activities like jogging and gardening haven’t changed.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you feel pain in your calf when you walk, and does it go away when you stop and rest?
turns.patient_answer: “No—when I walk I don’t get calf pain that forces me to stop, and it doesn’t seem to go away only with rest. My legs feel normal, and I’ve been able to jog and garden like usual.”
